name: Hangyaku no Daseijo Bianca
original_name: 叛逆の堕聖女ビアンカ
source:
Rebellion against God, born from a sacred womb.

The holy maiden Bianca, bearing the child of a demon.

Her pregnancy and childbirth begin to shake the foundation of faith itself.

Fallen into the hands of demons and forced to continuously bear their offspring, Bianca seeks a way out of her unbearable days. To escape her plight, she begins a forbidden experiment using the sacred power residing within her. As her once-pure body becomes corrupted and gradually mutates, she turns even these strange abnormalities into her own weapon.

Correcting the will of God that was warped by the Church, she embark on a path to become a deity herself—
